channel.title: Cybersecurity Study Command Center Membership study notes
channel.description: Turn authorized defensive-security practice into evidence you can explain with a free checklist or a prepared 12-sprint working system.

item.title: Cyber Risk Baseline Template for Students
item.description: An evidence-led method for documenting assets, risks, current safeguards, and priority decisions in a controlled cybersecurity study scenario.

item.title: Beginner Web Service Threat Model Example
item.description: A design-stage workflow for mapping assets, actors, data flows, trust boundaries, and reviewable security decisions for a small web service.

item.title: Secure Configuration Drift Checklist for Students
item.description: A practical method for defining an evidence-based configuration baseline and reviewing change safely in a disposable study environment.

item.title: Authentication and Session Security Review Checklist
item.description: An evidence-led design review for authentication, recovery, session handling, monitoring, and user-safe failure behavior.

item.title: Beginner API Authorization Test Matrix
item.description: A controlled workflow for reviewing object-level authorization, role boundaries, safe failure behavior, and abuse-resistant API decisions.

item.title: Secrets Lifecycle Checklist for Developers
item.description: A safe study method for mapping how synthetic secrets are created, stored, used, rotated, detected, revoked, and evidenced.

item.title: SBOM Review Workflow for Students
item.description: An evidence-led workflow for reviewing a software bill of materials, dependency identity, known risk signals, and documented remediation decisions.

item.title: Container Hardening Checklist for Students
item.description: A controlled container review covering provenance, privileges, filesystem access, configuration, resource boundaries, and evidence-led tradeoffs.

item.title: Network Segmentation Validation Checklist
item.description: An evidence-led method for translating approved communication needs into least-access network policy and reviewable validation cases.

item.title: Detection Engineering Portfolio Project Example
item.description: Inspect a synthetic detection engineering portfolio project with four events, positive and negative tests, tuning metrics, analyst handoff, and limitations.

item.title: Cyber Incident Response Tabletop Template
item.description: A structured tabletop method for testing roles, evidence handling, decisions, communications, recovery priorities, and follow-up actions.

item.title: Safe Ransomware Recovery Exercise Without Malware
item.description: A malware-free recovery exercise using disposable copies, integrity evidence, restore criteria, and documented recovery limitations.
